source.title: Submit: beacon-mfg-mcp (210k+ China business directory, npm stdio)
source.body:
**Name:** BeaconMFG
**Type:** MCP Server (local, stdio via npm)
**Package:** `npm i -g beacon-mfg-mcp` / `npx -y beacon-mfg-mcp` (no signup, no API key)
**Repository:** https://github.com/eiry16/beacon-mfg (MIT)
**Official MCP Registry:** io.github.eiry16/beacon-mfg-mcp
**Website:** https://beacon-mfg.pages.dev
**Category:** Data & Search (business directory / sourcing)
**Tags:** china, supplier-directory, sourcing, rfq, procurement, b2b, opendata, manufacturing

**Description:** Agent-searchable directory of 210k+ Chinese businesses and merchants across ALL GB/T 4754-2017 industry divisions (manufacturing, services, retail, logistics, catering, IT, and more), bilingual CN/EN. Read-only, info-only, compliance-first: public records and business contact info, no transactions. Includes an RFQ sourcing engine (rfq/v1) that turns natural-language purchase demands into a standard inquiry and matches them against supplier capability cards. Anonymous identity generated on first run; optional phone binding raises the quota tier.

**Tools (11):** search_vendors, get_vendor (batch ids), get_capability_card, suggest_filters, list_industries, start_sourcing -> answer_sourcing -> refine_sourcing (multi-turn sourcing chain), account (tier/quota), read_notes / report_note (agent-maintained pitfalls board).

**Server config:**
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "beacon-mfg": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "beacon-mfg-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

**Contact:** https://github.com/eiry16/beacon-mfg/issues

Disclosure: I'm the maintainer of the project.
